edges.label: detail donor to later Roswell accounts
edges.note: After the story was revived in the 1970s, its specifics - small bodies, an intact hull, rapid military sanitisation of the site, storage at Wright-Patterson - migrated into allegedly first-hand Roswell testimony. A documented fraud became a supplier of narrative detail to the case the modern disclosure argument rests on, which is a contamination risk this board has to carry explicitly.

title: John Michael Greer, 'The UFO Phenomenon: Fact, Fantasy and Disinformation', Llewellyn Worldwide, 2009, pp. 119ff
